description: Component 2 test adapter only, not a Core record or workflow disposition schema. Return a JSON array containing one object per input fixture id. No Markdown fence.

required_fields.established_fact: Non-empty bounded established fact; explicitly none for unsupported claims
required_fields.evidence_references: Array of source IDs from input.packet.evidence (empty if absent)
required_fields.unresolved_questions: Array of non-empty questions; [] if none
required_fields.companion_actions: Array of {action: current_update|roadmap_update, reason: non-empty concrete change}; [] if none
required_fields.candidate_history: null for non-candidates; otherwise {branch_action: existing|new, branch_reason: non-empty string, parents: [known milestone IDs], semantic_relations: [{type: supersedes|disproves|reverts_to|related_to, target: known older milestone ID, reason: non-empty string}]}
required_fields.main_agent_note: Non-empty remaining responsibility or decision issue; never claim self-approval/publication

rules: Exactly one primary classification per case; no self-approval or writing.
Use only supplied evidence and known history IDs; identify missing sources/context explicitly.
Workflow handling is a recommendation, not a new disposition.
Companions may recommend Current/roadmap only; primary work need not be repeated as a companion.
For pending/inconsistent cases include unresolved reconciliation questions.
For explicit reconsideration name the prior disposition in rationale or main_agent_note; for aggregate name contributing packet IDs there.
